title: Skyline Screamer
description: A screaming euphoric supersaw topline lead in mid-high register: a five-voice detuned saw stack that climbs a slow resonant filter journey while its bit depth crumbles from 16 down to 5 over 32 cycles, panning and breathing through room and delay. The crush ramp and filter sweep pull apart so each pass arrives brighter, dirtier, and more anthemic.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<f3 f3 ab3 c4>*4").s("supersaw")
    .unison(5).detune(saw.slow(29).range(0.18, 0.45))
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 5))
    .lpf(sine.slow(23).range(900, 6500))
    .resonance(sine.slow(13).range(8, 18))
    .lpenv(sine.slow(11).range(1.5, 4)).lpattack(0.02).lpdecay(0.14)
    .ftype("ladder")
    .shape(0.28)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .room(sine.slow(16).range(0.3, 0.7)).roomsize(5)
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.55").orbit(2)
    .gain(0.78)
)
